heldout.name: word_math
heldout.domain: grade-school arithmetic word problems (one or two steps, whole numbers)
heldout.description: 10 private templates (purchases, rates, groups, change, multi-step add/sub/mul) x 30 items each; answers are whole numbers.

sample_outputs_before.prompt: Maria has 83 stickers. She gives 10 to her brother and then buys 6 more. How many stickers does she have now?
sample_outputs_before.output:
Maria has 83 stickers.
She gives 10 stickers to her brother, so she now has 83 - 10 = 73 stickers.
She buys 6 more stickers, so she now has 73 + 6 = 89 stickers.
#### 89
The answer is: 89

sample_outputs_before.prompt: Maria has 40 stickers. She gives 14 to her brother and then buys 26 more. How many stickers does she have now?
sample_outputs_before.output:
Maria has 40 stickers.
She gives 14 stickers to her brother, so she now has 40 - 14 = 26 stickers.
She buys 26 more stickers, so she now has 26 + 26 = 42 stickers.
#### 42
The answer is: 42
